enchantments.tooltip: Blurry: Equipping this item causes you to become slightly blurry. Attacks from enemies have a 20% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Disable Device +17: Passive: +17 Competence bonus to the Disable Device skill.
Search +17: Passive: +17 Competence bonus to the Search skill.
Exceptional Seeker +3: Provides a +3 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +3 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Resistance +5: Passive: +5 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
